_doc: Snapshot chữ ký RPC critical. Khi DB thay đổi → chạy lại scripts/audit/dump-db-schema.sh + extract-all.mjs, đối chiếu test 'rpc signature drift', cập nhật file này VÀ các docs/architecture/01-modules/*.md tương ứng.

transition_room_status: _room_id uuid, _to_status text, _reason text DEFAULT NULL::text, _dnd_until timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, _oos_until timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, _force boolean DEFAULT false
transition_booking_status: _booking_id uuid, _to_status text, _reason text DEFAULT NULL::text, _amount_owed numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric
transition_task_status: _task_id uuid, _to_status text, _reason text DEFAULT NULL::text, _force boolean DEFAULT false
perform_checkin: p_booking_id uuid, p_room_id uuid, p_early_checkin_charge numeric DEFAULT 0
perform_checkout: p_booking_id uuid, p_room_id uuid, p_late_checkout_charge numeric DEFAULT 0, p_service_charges numeric DEFAULT 0, p_subtotal numeric DEFAULT 0, p_damage_charges numeric DEFAULT 0, p_damage_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_damage_items jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, p_new_amount_paid numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, p_check_out_date date DEFAULT NULL::date
prepare_checkout_amounts: p_booking_id uuid, p_room_id uuid, p_late_checkout_charge numeric DEFAULT 0, p_service_charges numeric DEFAULT 0, p_subtotal numeric DEFAULT 0, p_damage_charges numeric DEFAULT 0, p_damage_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_damage_items jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb

_knownIssues.has_role: Có 3 entry trong DB nhưng 2 là từ extension (sql lang, secdef=f). App-defined chỉ là (_user_id uuid, _role app_role).
